native.qualification: 48 normal/sanitized lifecycle scenarios across eight first inputs and three widths. Session-only reset preserves an unconsumed native prefix. Native capacity rejection precedes prefix consumption, and native skips consume prefixes. Seven scenarios use unchanged fixed capacity; the native-only short scenario deliberately changes capacity across reset and has no direct Rust fixed-output counterpart.

rust.qualification: Five independent storage selections each replay21 fixed-capacity claim/reset scenarios with real guards and weak-owner lifetime checks. Over-limit valid headers consume Rust prefixes before rejection, so reset releases them; native rejects capacity before consumption. Rust skips preserve prefixes; native skips consume them. Other retained scenarios agree on retry success. Native-only capacity replacement is not emulated.

qualification: Separate claim/reset supplement:48 native scenarios (normal/sanitized, eight initial inputs, three widths);105 Rust scenarios (five storage selections, seven unchanged-capacity initial inputs, three widths), with strict Clippy and formatting. Native-only capacity replacement has no direct fixed-output Rust counterpart. Actual guards and Rust weak-owner checks distinguish pre-claim parsing errors, valid over-limit headers, skips and completed standard frames. This does not inflate the earlier750 native/3750 Rust streaming campaign counts. The initially successful native capacity-only prototype and subsequent additional fixed-capacity header design are retained separately.
